ai_answer_surface_label: Example State official voter-information off-platform AI answer surface policy
authority_boundary_note: The current official page, signed notice, or direct office confirmation remains controlling even when an off-platform AI answer card summarizes or cites the page first.
citation_handoff_policy_note: Pages likely to be cited for action-changing topics should make jurisdiction, purpose, and current official routing legible immediately after click-through.
current_state_cue_policy_note: Volatile topics should expose visible current-state cues or current-cycle routing so stale synthesized summaries are easier to recover safely.
delivery_role_note: Off-platform AI answers may summarize or cite official voter information before click-through, but they do not become the controlling authority for jurisdiction-specific election rules.
high_risk_topic_routing_note: Address-specific, district-specific, record-specific, or rights-sensitive questions should keep visible office/help or escalation routing instead of pretending one summarized answer safely resolves every case.
scope_legibility_policy_note: Cited pages should identify the responsible office, election/date scope when material, and whether the page is a directory, notice, FAQ/help answer, or status page.
vendor_independence_note: The jurisdiction maintains citation-ready and recovery-rich official pages without depending on opaque vendor-specific optimization tactics.
